## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- WEDMKalmanFusionEngine.fuse — per-channel update
- initialises state on first measurement (gain = 1, innovation = 0)
- reduces innovation magnitude as more frames accumulate (variance drops)
- leaves channel null for a never-seen-before channel, reuses last if seen
- ignores non-finite measurements (NaN, Infinity)
- records innovation magnitude for downstream anomaly detection
